attrs.TuningNote: Phase 1 longitudinal dynamics. Disable Enabled for immediate legacy-force rollback.
attrs.DriftTuningNote: DriftGrip reduces boat-like slide; EngineAssist and VelocityAlignment pull momentum around the corner; SideForce creates rotation.
attrs.AccelerationTuningNote: Launch* controls 0-14 MPH; PowerBand* controls where tiered pull fades; AerodynamicDrag* controls high-speed resistance.
attrs.BoostTuningNote: Duration/Recharge min/max seconds are physical bounds; raw V2 boost stats still determine position within them.
attrs.OrganisedTuningNote: Select one category Folder and edit its numeric Attributes. Each matching _RaisingThisDoes string explains the higher-value effect.
attrs.HandlingTuningNote: SteeringResponse min/max multipliers compress E-S steering without changing rating stats.

attrs.PhysicalTopSpeedMinMph_RaisingThisDoes: Raises the lowest physical top speed the curve can produce.
attrs.WeightAccelerationMaxMultiplier_RaisingT: Improves the best acceleration multiplier for light vehicles.
attrs.PhysicalTopSpeedExponent_RaisingThisDoes: Widens tier speed differences: below-reference vehicles become slower and above-reference vehicles become faster.
attrs.HighSpeedAccelerationExponent_RaisingThi: Makes acceleration fall away more sharply after the power band.
attrs.HighSpeedAccelerationFloor_RaisingThisDo: Leaves more engine pull available very near top speed.
attrs.EngineOutputReference_RaisingThisDoes: Requires more EngineOutput to reach the reference acceleration multiplier.
attrs.LaunchRampEndMph_RaisingThisDoes: Extends the softer launch section to a higher speed.
attrs.WeightReference_RaisingThisDoes: Moves the weight point that counts as neutral for acceleration and braking.
attrs.WeightAccelerationMinMultiplier_RaisingT: Improves the worst acceleration multiplier for heavy vehicles.
attrs.BaseForwardAcceleration_RaisingThisDoes: Increases forward acceleration across the speed range.
attrs.PhysicalTopSpeedMaxMph_RaisingThisDoes: Raises the normal configurable ceiling for mapped physical top speed.
attrs.AbsoluteTopSpeedSafetyMph_RaisingThisDoe: Raises the final safety ceiling, but only when PhysicalTopSpeedMaxMph is also high enough.
attrs.TopSpeedRawReference_RaisingThisDoes: Reduces mapped physical speed for the same raw TopSpeed stat.
attrs.LaunchAccelerationMultiplier_RaisingThis: Makes the initial launch below the ramp speed stronger.
attrs.PowerBandStartRatioLow_RaisingThisDoes: Lets low-power vehicles retain strong pull closer to top speed.
attrs.PowerBandStartRatioHigh_RaisingThisDoes: Lets high-power vehicles retain strong pull closer to top speed.
attrs.WeightAccelerationExponent_RaisingThisDo: Makes vehicle weight affect acceleration more strongly.
attrs.SoftLimiterStrength_RaisingThisDoes: Pushes the vehicle back under its forward or reverse speed limit more strongly.
attrs.EngineOutputMaxMultiplier_RaisingThisDoe: Raises the maximum acceleration available to high-power vehicles.
attrs.LaunchEngineInfluence_RaisingThisDoes: Makes engine-power differences more noticeable during launch.
attrs.EngineOutputMinMultiplier_RaisingThisDoe: Raises the minimum acceleration available to low-power vehicles.
attrs.AerodynamicDragStatExponent_RaisingThisD: Makes the vehicle Drag stat influence air resistance more strongly.
attrs.PhysicalTopSpeedAtReferenceMph_RaisingTh: Raises the physical top speed of every vehicle around the reference stat.
attrs.EngineOutputExponent_RaisingThisDoes: Widens acceleration differences between weak and powerful engines.
attrs.DragReference_RaisingThisDoes: Requires a higher Drag stat to reach the neutral air-resistance point.
attrs.AerodynamicDragPerMphSquared_RaisingThis: Adds more speed-squared air resistance at high speed.

attrs.BasePhysicalSteeringResponse_RaisingThis: Makes every vehicle turn more quickly.
attrs.SteeringWeightMaxMultiplier_RaisingThisD: Improves the best steering multiplier for light vehicles.
attrs.SteeringResponseMaxMultiplier_RaisingThi: Raises the maximum steering available to high-stat vehicles.
attrs.SteeringResponseExponent_RaisingThisDoes: Widens the steering difference between low- and high-stat vehicles.
attrs.SteeringWeightMinMultiplier_RaisingThisD: Improves the worst steering multiplier for heavy vehicles.
attrs.SteeringResponseMinMultiplier_RaisingThi: Improves the minimum steering available to low-stat vehicles.
attrs.SteeringResponseReference_RaisingThisDoe: Requires more SteeringResponse stat to reach neutral steering.
attrs.SteeringWeightInfluenceExponent_RaisingT: Makes weight influence steering and drift control more strongly.

attrs.DriftMiniBoostChargeForFullReward_Raisin: Requires a longer or faster-charging drift to reach the full reward.
attrs.PhysicalDriftControlExponent_RaisingThis: Widens physical drift-control differences between vehicle stats.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostMaxAcceleration_RaisingThi: Makes a fully charged reference post-drift boost accelerate harder.
attrs.DriftGripReference_RaisingThisDoes: Requires more DriftGrip stat to reach neutral drift grip.
attrs.DriftControlReference_RaisingThisDoes: Requires more DriftControl stat to reach neutral drift authority.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostBoostForceMinMultiplier_Ra: Raises the post-drift power floor for low-force boost modules.
attrs.BaseDriftLateralGrip_RaisingThisDoes: Adds drift grip and reduces boat-like sideways sliding.
attrs.DriftForwardDragBase_RaisingThisDoes: Removes more forward speed throughout a drift.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostBoostDurationMaxMultiplier: Raises the duration multiplier ceiling for high-duration boost modules.
attrs.DriftControlExponent_RaisingThisDoes: Makes DriftControl affect turning and alignment more strongly.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostBoostDurationReferenceSeco: Requires a higher mapped BoostDuration to reach the neutral duration multiplier.
attrs.BaseDriftSideForce_RaisingThisDoes: Adds more sideways turning force while drifting.
attrs.DriftGripExponent_RaisingThisDoes: Makes the DriftGrip stat affect remaining slide more strongly.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostAbsoluteMaxDurationSeconds: Raises the final safety cap for post-drift boost duration.
attrs.PhysicalDriftControlMinMultiplier_Raisin: Improves minimum drift control on low-stat vehicles.
attrs.BasePhysicalDriftControl_RaisingThisDoes: Increases the baseline drift turning authority for every vehicle.
attrs.DriftChargeExponent_RaisingThisDoes: Makes DriftChargeRate change drift-charge speed more strongly.
attrs.PhysicalDriftControlMaxMultiplier_Raisin: Raises maximum drift control on high-stat vehicles.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostBoostDurationExponent_Rais: Widens post-drift duration differences between low- and high-duration boost modules.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostBaseMaxDurationSeconds_Rai: Makes a fully charged reference post-drift boost last longer before stat scaling.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostForceApplicationMultiplier: Raises the final physical force applied by every post-drift boost.
attrs.DriftForwardDragBlendExtra_RaisingThisDo: Adds more forward-speed loss as the drift reaches full blend.
attrs.DriftVelocityAlignmentMaxAcceleration_Ra: Allows a stronger maximum momentum-alignment force during a drift.
attrs.DriftChargeReference_RaisingThisDoes: Requires more DriftChargeRate to reach neutral drift-charge speed.
attrs.DriftThrottleMinimum_RaisingThisDoes: Requires more accelerator input before drift drive and alignment activate.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostRewardExponent_RaisingThis: Makes partially charged drifts produce less duration and force.
attrs.DriftEngineAssist_RaisingThisDoes: Adds more forward engine drive while acceleration is held in a drift.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostBoostForceReference_Raisin: Requires a higher BoostForce stat to reach the neutral post-drift force multiplier.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostMinimumCharge_RaisingThisD: Requires more earned drift charge before any post-drift reward is granted.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostMinAcceleration_RaisingThi: Makes the weakest qualifying post-drift boost accelerate harder.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostExpiresDuringNormalBoost_R: Makes the post-drift reward expire instead of queueing behind normal boost when raised to 1.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostStatScalingEnabled_Raising: Enables the new charge, BoostForce, and BoostDuration scaling when raised to 1; set 0 for the legacy reward formula.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostBoostForceMaxMultiplier_Ra: Raises the post-drift power multiplier ceiling for high-force boost modules.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostBoostForceExponent_Raising: Widens post-drift power differences between low- and high-force boost modules.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostBoostDurationMinMultiplier: Raises the duration floor for low-duration boost modules.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostBaseMinDurationSeconds_Rai: Makes the shortest charge-based post-drift boost last longer.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostAbsoluteMinDurationSeconds: Raises the absolute shortest post-drift boost duration.
attrs.DriftVelocityAlignmentRate_RaisingThisDo: Pulls vehicle momentum around the direction of the corner more quickly.

attrs.BoostRechargeReferenceSeconds_RaisingThi: Makes the reference boost recharge take longer.
attrs.BoostRechargeDelayMaxSeconds_RaisingThis: Raises the longest delay before boost starts recharging.
attrs.BoostRechargeDelayMinSeconds_RaisingThis: Raises the shortest delay before boost starts recharging.
attrs.BoostDurationExponent_RaisingThisDoes: Widens boost-duration differences between low- and high-stat vehicles.
attrs.BoostDurationMinSeconds_RaisingThisDoes: Makes the shortest possible boost last longer.
attrs.BoostRechargeExponent_RaisingThisDoes: Widens recharge-time differences between low- and high-stat vehicles.
attrs.BoostDurationMaxSeconds_RaisingThisDoes: Makes the longest possible boost last longer.
attrs.BoostRechargeMinSeconds_RaisingThisDoes: Makes even the fastest possible recharge take longer.
attrs.BoostRechargeDelayExponent_RaisingThisDo: Makes the vehicle recharge-delay stat affect the physical delay more strongly.
attrs.BoostRechargeMaxSeconds_RaisingThisDoes: Makes the slowest possible recharge take longer.
attrs.BoostDurationReferenceSeconds_RaisingThi: Makes the reference boost charge last longer.
attrs.BoostEfficiencyTimingExponent_RaisingThi: Makes BoostEfficiency influence boost duration and recharge more strongly.

attrs.AutoHoldMph_RaisingThisDoes: Engages the stationary parking hold at a higher speed.
attrs.BaseBrakeDeceleration_RaisingThisDoes: Makes braking stronger for every vehicle.
attrs.ThrottleDeadzone_RaisingThisDoes: Requires more input before acceleration or braking registers.
attrs.CoastSpeedCoefficient_RaisingThisDoes: Adds more coasting slowdown as speed increases.
attrs.BrakeWeightExponent_RaisingThisDoes: Makes vehicle weight influence braking more strongly.
attrs.StopThresholdMph_RaisingThisDoes: Allows stopped/brake-to-reverse logic to engage at a higher speed.
attrs.ReverseCurveExponent_RaisingThisDoes: Makes reverse acceleration fade more sharply near reverse top speed.
attrs.BrakingForceExponent_RaisingThisDoes: Widens braking differences between low- and high-stat vehicles.
attrs.BrakingForceReference_RaisingThisDoes: Requires more BrakingForce stat to reach neutral braking performance.
attrs.CoastBaseDeceleration_RaisingThisDoes: Makes an unpowered vehicle slow down more quickly at all speeds.

attrs.HoverStabilityReference_RaisingThisDoes: Requires more HoverStability stat to reach neutral alignment response.
attrs.HoverStabilityExponent_RaisingThisDoes: Widens hover-alignment differences between stability stats.
attrs.LateralGripReference_RaisingThisDoes: Requires more LateralGrip stat to reach neutral cornering grip.
attrs.LateralGripExponent_RaisingThisDoes: Widens cornering-grip differences between vehicle stats.
attrs.LateralGripMinMultiplier_RaisingThisDoes: Improves the minimum grip available to low-stat vehicles.
attrs.DownforceReference_RaisingThisDoes: Requires more Downforce stat to reach neutral high-speed grip.
attrs.HighSpeedGripMph_RaisingThisDoes: Delays the point where the full downforce grip contribution is reached.
attrs.LateralGripMaxMultiplier_RaisingThisDoes: Raises maximum grip for high-stat vehicles.
attrs.BaseNormalLateralGrip_RaisingThisDoes: Adds more normal cornering grip to every vehicle.
attrs.BaseAlignResponsiveness_RaisingThisDoes: Makes hover orientation align more quickly for every vehicle.
attrs.DownforceGripInfluence_RaisingThisDoes: Makes Downforce add more grip as speed rises.

attrs.AerodynamicDragCoefficient_RaisingThisDo: Raises this advanced numeric value; inspect its name and driving documentation before changing it.
attrs.AccelerationCurveExponent_RaisingThisDoe: Raises this advanced numeric value; inspect its name and driving documentation before changing it.

attrs.AccelBrakeTiltNotes: Positive/negative pitch direction may depend on the live vehicle orientation. If acceleration or braking tilts the wrong way, flip the sign of the matching degrees value.
attrs.InputOwnedSteeringTurnBankNotes: Raw left/right input remains the sole bank owner. SteeringDriveMode restores original reverse yaw, retains forward mode while braking, and switches to forward immediately on forward throttle during a three-point turn.
attrs.SpeedSteeringNotes: LowMultiplier boosts low-speed turning, HighMultiplier softens high-speed turning, CurveExponent controls how aggressively low-speed assist ramps in, ReverseSteeringMultiplier tunes reverse separately, BoostSteeringMultiplier stacks on top while normal boost or drift mini-boost is active.
attrs.DriftMiniBoostNotes: When DriftMiniBoostRequiresAcceleration is true, releasing drift only grants mini-boost if throttle is above DriftMiniBoostAccelerationThreshold. ReverseMaxMph controls reverse top speed.
attrs.SlopeHoverNotes: Fixes uphill/downhill hover-height drift by damping vertical velocity relative to expected slope-following vertical motion instead of raw world-Y velocity. ForceAlongGroundNormal is optional and off by default.

attrs.ScriptedChaseEnabled_Description: True: scripted chase camera (lens locked to the car, springs for every relative motion). False: the V6.1 camera where Roblox owns motion, collision and orbit.
attrs.ChaseAimHeightStuds_RaisingThisDoes: Raises the point the chase camera looks at.
attrs.ChaseCutDistanceStuds_RaisingThisDoes: Requires a longer single-frame jump before the chase camera cuts instead of following.
attrs.RespectTrailerCameraKeys_Description: Lets P, C, and V release this controller until B resumes it.
attrs.ChaseOcclusionRadiusStuds_RaisingThisDoe: Keeps the chase camera farther from walls.
attrs.ChaseHeightStuds_RaisingThisDoes: Raises the chase camera above the vehicle.
attrs.LookAheadStuds_RaisingThisDoes: Moves the initial look target farther ahead of the vehicle.
attrs.LockPlayerZoom_Description: Prevents the player changing camera distance while driving.
attrs.InitialLookApplyFrames_RaisingThisDoes: Applies framing across more initialization frames so Roblox reliably adopts the configured angle; this is not continuous driving control.
attrs.ChasePitchFollow_RaisingThisDoes: Makes the chase camera follow more of the vehicle's nose-up and nose-down pitch on slopes.
attrs.HighSpeedStartMph_RaisingThisDoes: Makes high-speed camera effects begin at a higher speed.
attrs.ChaseAccelLagMaxStuds_RaisingThisDoes: Allows a larger pull-back and push-in.
attrs.ChaseLookReturnDelaySeconds_RaisingThisD: Waits longer after free look before the chase camera returns behind the vehicle.
attrs.ChaseAccelLagStudsPerAccel_RaisingThisDo: Pulls the chase camera back more under acceleration and pushes it in more under braking.
attrs.HighSpeedFullMph_RaisingThisDoes: Makes high-speed camera effects reach full strength at a higher speed.
attrs.HighSpeedFieldOfView_RaisingThisDoes: Widens the view at high speed.
attrs.DebugEnabled_Description: Publishes simple live camera diagnostics on Workspace.CurrentCamera.
attrs.ChaseDriftShiftResponse_RaisingThisDoes: Makes the drift side shift arrive and recover faster.
attrs.HighSpeedDistanceStuds_RaisingThisDoes: Moves the camera farther back at high speed.
attrs.BoostBlendSmoothing_RaisingThisDoes: Makes boost camera effects engage and release faster.
attrs.ChaseSpeedLinesEnabled_Description: Shows speed streaks at the screen edges at high speed and during boost.
attrs.ChasePivotHeightStuds_RaisingThisDoes: Raises the point the chase camera orbits around.
attrs.ChaseVerticalResponse_RaisingThisDoes: Makes the chase camera follow bumps and drops more tightly.
attrs.ChaseEntryBlendSeconds_RaisingThisDoes: Lengthens the blend into the chase camera when driving starts.
attrs.DefaultDistanceStuds_RaisingThisDoes: Moves the normal camera farther from the vehicle.
attrs.BoostDistanceStuds_RaisingThisDoes: Moves the camera farther back during boost.
attrs.DefaultPitchDegrees_RaisingThisDoes: Raises the initial camera position and makes it look down more steeply.
attrs.DefaultHeightStuds_RaisingThisDoes: Raises the initial camera position above the vehicle.
attrs.Enabled_Description: Turns the default vehicle camera controller on.
attrs.ChaseLookAheadSeconds_RaisingThisDoes: Turns the view farther into a corner.
attrs.ChaseSpeedLineCount_RaisingThisDoes: Draws more speed streaks (halved on touch devices). Read when a drive starts.
attrs.ChaseMinDistanceStuds_RaisingThisDoes: Keeps the chase camera farther from the vehicle when a wall pushes it in.
attrs.ChaseDriftShiftStuds_RaisingThisDoes: Moves the view farther toward the inside of the corner while the vehicle slides, putting the vehicle more off-centre. 0 turns the side shift off.
attrs.ChaseSlipFollow_RaisingThisDoes: Moves the chase camera farther toward the direction of travel while the vehicle slides, showing more of its side.
attrs.AccelerationBlendSmoothing_RaisingThisDo: Makes acceleration camera effects engage and release faster.
attrs.ConfigRefreshSeconds_RaisingThisDoes: Waits longer before live config edits are reread.
attrs.ChaseSpeedLineStartMph_RaisingThisDoes: Makes speed streaks begin at a higher speed.
attrs.ChaseLookMouseRadiansPerPixel_RaisingThi: Makes right-mouse free look turn faster.
attrs.ChaseSpeedLineFullMph_RaisingThisDoes: Makes speed streaks reach full strength at a higher speed.
attrs.ConfigNote: Roblox owns continuous motion, collision and orbit. V6.1 applies initial framing for only InitialLookApplyFrames frames.
attrs.ChaseYawResponse_RaisingThisDoes: Makes the chase camera swing behind the vehicle faster when it turns.
attrs.ChaseLookAheadMaxDegrees_RaisingThisDoes: Allows the view to turn farther into a corner.
attrs.DefaultYawDegrees_RaisingThisDoes: Rotates the initial camera position farther around the vehicle.
attrs.ChaseAimAheadStuds_RaisingThisDoes: Aims the chase camera farther ahead of the vehicle, which moves the vehicle lower in frame.
attrs.ChaseTurnRollDegreesPerRadian_RaisingThi: Leans the chase camera more for the same rate of turn.
attrs.LookTargetHeightStuds_RaisingThisDoes: Raises the initial point the camera looks toward.
attrs.ChaseFovDollyExponent_RaisingThisDoes: Moves the chase camera closer as the field of view widens, keeping the vehicle nearer its normal size on screen.
attrs.ChaseRollResponse_RaisingThisDoes: Makes the chase camera lean and recover faster.
attrs.AccelerationDistanceStuds_RaisingThisDoe: Moves the camera farther back while accelerating.
attrs.ChaseSlipRoll_RaisingThisDoes: Leans the chase camera more while the vehicle slides or drifts.
attrs.ApplyInitialLookAngle_Description: Applies configured framing briefly on entry and after framing edits, then returns full camera ownership to Roblox.
attrs.ChaseLookTouchRadiansPerPixel_RaisingThi: Makes touch free look turn faster.
attrs.ChaseLookReturnRate_RaisingThisDoes: Returns the chase camera behind the vehicle faster after free look.
attrs.ChaseRollMaxDegrees_RaisingThisDoes: Allows the chase camera to lean farther in turns and drifts.
attrs.ChaseShakeScale_RaisingThisDoes: Strengthens impact, landing, boost and high-speed camera shake. 0 turns shake off.
attrs.ChaseBoostPunchDegrees_RaisingThisDoes: Widens the brief field-of-view punch when a boost starts.
attrs.ChaseBoostKickStudsPerSecond_RaisingThis: Throws the chase camera back harder when a boost starts.
